gloss: to be prepared; to be in order; to be arranged

definitions.gloss: to be prepared; to be ready
definitions.explanation: A state where everything needed is in place.

definitions.gloss: to be in order; to be organized
definitions.explanation: Things being properly arranged or structured.

definitions.gloss: to be well-balanced; to be harmonious
definitions.explanation: Features or elements being in good proportion.

examples.japanese: {準備|じゅんび}が{整|ととの}った。
{環境|かんきょう}が{整|ととの}ってから{始|はじ}めましょう。
examples.english: Let's start once the environment is set up.
examples.notes: [Note: {整|ととの}ってから = 'once ~ is ready']

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{顔立|かおだ}ちが{整|ととの}っている。

notes:
{整|ととの}う is an intransitive verb ({自動詞|じどうし}). The transitive pair is {整|ととの}える (to prepare, to arrange).

ASPECT ({ている}):
The ている form indicates a resulting state ({準備|じゅんび}が{整|ととの}っている = 'preparations are in place').

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [thing]が{整|ととの}う (~ becomes ready/organized)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {準備|じゅんび}が{整|ととの}う (preparations are complete)
- {体制|たいせい}が{整|ととの}う (system is in place)
- {条件|じょうけん}が{整|ととの}う (conditions are met)
- {顔立|かおだ}ちが{整|ととの}っている (have well-proportioned features)
